title: scope-lock-triggers-and-release-readiness-matrix-for-api-console-runtime
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Create a unified readiness matrix and automated scope-lock triggers that coordinate the API, Console, and Runtime components. This ticket defines the milestone gating signals (telemetry, regressions, infra capacity), the communication pattern for release notes and GTM artifacts, and the exceptions workflow for last-minute critical fixes. The goal is to remove ambiguity at cut windows across teams and enable a predictable, auditable scope-lock process.
progress_updates: 2026-02-11: Kickoff with Eng leads (runtime/batching, api infra) and Console PMs. Captured initial set of gating signals and a strawman matrix.
2026-02-18: SRE proposed adding a capacity buffer signal (99th p99 token latency under target and GPU headroom > 20%). Added as soft gate.
2026-02-24: Design provided templates for release notes with component-level change bullets and rollout impact tags. Draft published to Drive (see links).

2026-03-01: Product review: agreed to three hard triggers (critical regressions >0.5% on eval set, blocking security issues, and failing canary for 30+ minutes) and two soft triggers (latency drift + cost delta). Documented exceptions flow requiring VP-level signoff.
2026-03-01: Draft of automation runbook created; PR opened to add scope-lock checks to release orchestration pipeline (see links).
decisions: Adopt a two-tier gating model: hard gates (block release) and soft gates (require mitigation plan).
Release notes will include per-component impact tags: behavior-change, perf-change, config-change, rollout-dependent. Templates standardized by Design.
Exceptions will be routed through a 3-person triage (PM, Eng lead, Security) with VP escalation for approvals outside the cutoff window.
next_steps: Implement automated checks in the release pipeline to fail fast on hard gates (ENG owners).
Create a rollout schedule template for Sales/CS that maps component changes to customer-facing comms (PM owners).
Finalize the release notes checklist and assign owners for each component's bullet points (Design + Eng + Docs).
Coordinate dry-run for the next internal release window to validate gating signals and signoff process on 2026-03-12.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline rejects a release candidate when any hard gate is met in staging.
Release notes template populated for API, Console, and Runtime with assigned owners before scope-lock cutoff.
Dry-run executed and postmortem produced with <5 action items to close before ship.
release_notes_coordination: Centralized doc in Drive with sectioned tabs per component. Each component owner must fill the 'customer-impact' and 'rollback-signal' fields 48 hours before scope-lock. Communications lead will assemble the final notes and coordinate embargo windows with Marketing.
rollout_strategy: Staggered rollout: start with dedicated customers on staging, then canary 5% on Hosted API, expand to 25% after 1 hour if no regressions, then full. Runtime-specific fallbacks: automatic model variant downgrade and region failover. Console changes behind feature flags with telemetry hooks.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Late-breaking runtime perf regression discovered post-cut. Mitigation: pre-cut stress tests and a 2-hour blocked freeze window where any perf regression requires immediate rollback plan.
Risk: Incomplete release notes from component owners. Mitigation: automated reminder 72h/48h/24h before cutoff and gating of release if notes not marked 'ready'.
Risk: Cross-team misalignment on rollback thresholds. Mitigation: agree common thresholds in the matrix and add them to the runbook; require signoff from each component owner.
